title: Input equality formula bounds
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $C,n,s$ be natural numbers such that $C$ is at least the number of states plus $6$ times the number of work tapes plus $5$. The CNF formula enforcing equality of the input bits in a pair of configuration codes has at most $2C(s+n+1)$ variables, and its binary serialization has length at most $6n(2C(s+n+1)+3)+1$.
